commits.subject: core: (hopefully) one last fpcx64mm pass for Win64 ABI fixes
commits.body: - there is no "push/pop" anymore in our asm for Win64 :)
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: fixed fpcx64mm on Win64 ABI
commits.body:
- don't modify rsp on Win64: let FPC manage alignment and shadow space
- use local stack storage instead of push/pop
- POSIX/Linux will continue to use a faster path with no stack frame
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
